data.body:
[P1] Delay late-registered skips until the parent checkpoint succeeds

`shouldSkipBranch()` now reads `cachedResult`, which is populated before serialization and submission of the parent's `SUCCEED` checkpoint. A branch registered in that window completes immediately here. Its caller can catch `ParallelBranchSkippedException` and checkpoint subsequent work before the skip decision is durable. An interruption then allows replay to execute that branch, changing control flow against those subsequent checkpoints. Reserve late-registered skips without exposing them, and publish them only after acknowledged parent completion; immediate publication is safe when replaying an already-persisted parent.
